rca_of_issues.dashboard_missing_25: en-US.json is missing nav.calendar, nav.content_studio, nav.client_relations, nav.design_journeys, nav.moodboards, nav.material_boards, nav.specifications, nav.project_stories, nav.knowledge_engine keys (flat nav keys, different from nav.client_relations_accounts). rca_of_issues.journey_no_error_state: DesignJourneyTab.jsx likely has no .catch() or error boundary for the /api/projects/:id/journey API call. When the project ID doesn't exist, the API returns 404/empty and the component stays in loading state.
rca_of_issues.it_crm_prospects_13_missing: it-IT.json is missing 13 keys used by the CRM Prospects page. The sprint only fixed these for en-US.json.
